rubrics.justification: Accurately describes an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single static image, though some finer observations are somewhat inferential.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrial thickness, prior IVF outcomes, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking good morphology with favorable baseline factors while tempering prognosis due to prior losses and failed cycles; minor overreach in attributing recurrent issues to chromosomal competence without stronger evidence.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with common IVF practice: SET for a good-quality blastocyst at age 33, cautious use of adjuncts, and selective consideration of RPL workup and PGT-A; a few suggestions are broader than strictly guideline-driven.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, uterine/tubal reassessment, and targeted further workup; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
